goal: Improve Phoenix quantitative rigor at zero software/service cost without claiming unsupported quantum advantage.

current_stack.simulation: Monte Carlo, Sobol/QMC, permutation tests, walk-forward/OOS
current_stack.quantum: qiskit and qiskit-aer installed; current production path remains classical fallback
current_stack.free_data: yfinance, FRED/public sources, optional xfinlink when configured
current_stack.free_compute: local CPU, GitHub Actions, optional Colab; no paid API required

stages.name: measurement baseline
work: compare current MC/Sobol/classical optimizer against empirical baseline
stages.gate: no quantum candidate proceeds unless it beats or matches baseline OOS without resource regression

stages.name: quantum-inspired basket search
work: encode basket selection as QUBO-like constrained objective
solve with deterministic classical local search and simulated annealing
stages.gate: incremental fixed-24m OOS lift with no leakage

stages.name: local quantum simulation research
work: run small QAOA/VQE experiments in Qiskit Aer only
limit problem size to fit 8GB RAM
use fixed seeds and publish circuit depth/noise/runtime
stages.gate: research artifact only; must beat classical baseline on identical instances

stages.name: risk and payoff verification
stages.gate: all safety and recalculation contracts pass

stages.name: promotion review
work: verified dealer quote-fit and realized outcomes
stages.gate: human review required; no automatic production mutation

zero_cost_policy: no paid API or cloud dependency
local Ollama optional and never evidence
GitHub Actions artifacts are temporary research outputs
public/free data must retain provenance and licensing status
non_claims: quantum hardware is not available locally
Qiskit simulation is not quantum advantage
historical replay is not a settled note
free data does not equal dealer-quality evidence
